quest.title: Science of Data Management
quest.description: It seems that Chalmet is still buried under various chores at the Materials Office...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: That should do it... I hope these materials will actually be useful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still organizing files?

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Oho! Pleasure to see you, Honorary Senior Researcher.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: That's correct! I am continuing to organize the documents and files according to Mr. Raimondo's instructions... Wait, haven't I said this before?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But this place is huge! It's way too much work for one person. Why didn't he assign anyone to help you?

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: The Research Institute has many pressing matters to deal with. It's normal that there's no one available to help me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you're a Director too...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: You mean my title as Fontaine Research Institute Materials Retrieval Project Director? *sigh* Please don't mock me so...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: In what way am I actually a Director? From the very beginning, I have been no more than an ordinary staffer responsible for organizing files.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: After Mr. Raimondo assigned me here to organize the files, I was suddenly informed of my new title.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Someone said this was Mr. Choiseul's idea. Apparently he thinks that since our work is so onerous, giving us such titles will make providing additional compensation easier...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Ah! Don't tell anyone else, how could I... how could I just say it out loud like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm the silent type, relax.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds not bad at all! And after all, it's only fair that those who do all the work should receive a bit more compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But why use such a roundabout method? Can't they just give everyone more Mora?

choices.text: This seems par for the course here at the Research Institute.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: *sigh* I can never understand just what the two of them are thinking...

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: But I have to keep working, no matter what! There's too much to do.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Honorary Senior Researcher, if you are willing, could you please give me a hand?

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: In that case, please help me clear out some of the filth around here.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Be sure to do your best <color=#00E1FFFF>not to touch the nearby books and files</color> while you're cleaning. It would be absolutely awful if they were damaged by the cleaning...

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: I'll leave that to you then! As for me, I'll keep organizing the files here. *sigh* I never noticed there were so many files in the Institute before...

choices.text: Don't forget to make the "honorary" in my title even more honorable!

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Hahaha, not a problem! I will testify to your kindness and contributions.

choices.text: As long as you actually receive the extra Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: *sigh* I never noticed there were so many files in the Institute before...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Phew... Thanks for your help. Were it not for you, who knows how long it would have taken me...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: No wonder you're the Honorary Senior Researcher. No matter what you do, you do it well.

choices.text: I've always been a bit out of the ordinary.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: I must thank you again for your help, Honorary Senior Researcher. Please, take these.

choices.text: I've got some experience in the cleaning department.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Huh? Then you truly are multitalented, and eminently worthy of your title!

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Phew... Thanks for your help. Were it not for you, who knows how long it would have taken me...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Though, if you had been a bit gentler with the cleaning, that would have been even better...

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Don't misunderstand! I'm not blaming you, you really did do me a huge favor.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: These are for you. Thank you for your help, Honorary Senior Researcher.

choices.text: I'll go a bit easier next time...
